annotations.title: Install steps for a mail client

description: How to add, change or install an email signature in a mail client, honestly: Gmail web (paste, or the sendAs PATCH with gmail.settings.basic — new mail only), Gmail mobile, Outlook (copy-paste only, no directory sync), Apple Mail, iPhone, and google_workspace (the one-time super-admin approval: client ID, scopes, admin console path). The free Chrome extension (auto-updates, covers replies) needs the human to sign up first.
